description: A British man in his late twenties, deep baritone, received pronunciation, very measured and precise, cool and reserved, speaks less than he means, faint dryness, no warmth on the surface, slow deliberate pacing, quiet authority.
text: Hertfordshire sets a modest ceiling, Miss Frost. I wonder if you find it so. Sir William's superlatives seldom disappoint; in your case, they have not misled him. I assure you, I look at nothing in particular. My sister is sixteen. She would sooner face a regiment than a room like this one.
